subject: Problem bootstrap standard errors that blow up

messages.author: e5c4db1a1cffab6b
messages.subject: Problem bootstrap standard errors that blow up
parts:
Hello

I have a problem with the bootstrap standard errors (se='bootstrap') when I estimate a factor model and then use the factor scores to estimate a regression - the estimation is done in one-step. When I estimate robust standard errors, I get reliable results.

When I estimate bootstrap standard errors, I get huge standard errors which I think are due to two reasons. (1) there are some failed convergences in the bootstrap estimation steps. (2) Some bootstrap repetitions, take many iterations to converge (too many!) - I can see this when I set VERBOSE =TRUE. This probably gives me some very unreliable bootstrap estimates.

My question is: Is there a way to tell lavaan to stop looking for an estimate when the bootstrap model takes too many iterations to converge? 

This would get rid of the bootstrap estimates that are probably outliers because of failed convergence or too many iterations.

Thank you
Ale Dea

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Problem bootstrap standard errors that blow up
parts:
What is the bootstrapping is for?  If you want to trust your SEs with factor-score regression, request robust SEs when you fit the model, then use the plausibleValues() function and treat them like multiple imputations of missing data.
